summary: Universal stat canonicalizer testing complete. All 93 pytest tests pass. All live API endpoints return canonical stat_types with zero long-form (player_*) or _default leakage. Critical regression verified: Ayo Dosunmu PR 19.5 OVER is in War Zone with stat_type='PR' and vision_score=87.1. DB verification confirms NBA prop_scores has ZERO long-form stat_types and MLB prop_scores has ZERO _default leakage. All direct module tests pass including validate_sport, miss_counters, stat_family resolution, strict mode, and pluggability. Concurrent safety verified with 6 parallel requests returning 200 with no errors.
